observations.body: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The woman flees to a prepared place and is nourished for a numbered time.
observations.label: A prepared refuge

observations.body: The woman’s wilderness flight leads to a prepared place and numbered care while conflict continues elsewhere.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Revelation 12:4–8 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Protection is real, but it does not end the wider conflict.
payload.title: A place prepared in the wilderness
